name: Sunn O)))
label: Southern Lord
lede: Stephen O'Malley and Greg Anderson stack Sunn amps as a tribute to Earth, then spend 25 years turning the hum into cathedral sets, a Scott Walker album and a self-titled record on Sub Pop.

eras.title: An Earth tribute, in Sunn amps
eras.text: O'Malley comes out of Burning Witch and Anderson out of Goatsnake. They build a tribute to Earth from amplifiers, and Anderson starts a label to put the records on.

years.h: Anderson opens Southern Lord in April
years.p: The label's first releases are Thorr's Hammer and [[Burning Witch|e5d4491d-1496-4efa-a5b9-e7be001b9f6a]]. A Sunn O))) record won't carry the name until 2002.

yt: Rig rundown with O'Malley and Anderson
years.h: Sunn amps give the band its name; Earth gives it the idea
years.p: Sunn O))) forms in Seattle in 1998 and takes its name from the amplifier brand. O'Malley has said it also plays on [[Earth|60dd41cf-8f9d-46d8-bc19-dc7e5acb24c8]].
years.xp:
Before relocating to Los Angeles, the pair played briefly under the name Mars.

O'Malley came from [[Burning Witch|e5d4491d-1496-4efa-a5b9-e7be001b9f6a]] and Anderson from [[Goatsnake|ae720a02-629e-4e9b-98e7-d1f637bd5a49]]. Sunn O))) began as a tribute to Earth, the 1990s pioneers of drone metal.

years.h: Hydra Head puts out The Grimmrobe Demos
years.p: The first Sunn O))) recording is a duo of O'Malley and Anderson, produced by Mathias Schneeberger. Pressing: 500 copies.
years.xp: The demos were later reissued as a double picture-disc by Outlaw Recordings, and again by Southern Lord in 2004.

years.h: ØØ Void gets 2-inch tape and a Hollywood studio
years.p: Producer Scott Reeder records it at Grandmaster Studios, and the sound is far cleaner than the demos. It includes a cover of the Melvins' "Rabbits' Revenge".
years.xp:
It came out on Hydra Head in North America and Rise Above in Europe, with Dirter Productions pressing a double vinyl.

Pitchfork later gave it 7.5 out of 10. Southern Lord reissued it in 2011 in a single-disc edition with new artwork; a 2008 Japanese edition added a collaboration with Nurse with Wound.

years.big: "At one point I actually laid down behind the amps and fell asleep for like 10 minutes."
years.h: London's Underworld gets a wall of amps and no band
years.p: Anderson on an early UK tour with Goatsnake and Orange Goblin: the band pushed the amps to the front of the stage and stood behind them.
years.xp:
Anderson told The Quietus the crowds on that tour weren't receptive. The Underworld show was one of his favourites anyway: "It has to be one of my favourite shows ever."

The way forward, he said: "We've got to come up with something where we feel comfortable." The answer was robes and fog, which gave anonymity so the night wasn't about any one person.

eras.title: The fog thickens and a Mayhem singer arrives
eras.text: Southern Lord becomes home base, and in 2003 Attila Csihar turns a two-man drone into a ritual. White1 and White2 open the doors; Black One lets black metal into the room.

years.h: A Metallica song gets the drone treatment on Flight of the Behemoth
years.p: Southern Lord's first Sunn O))) record is produced by Anderson and Mathias Schneeberger and includes collaborations with Merzbow.

years.cap: Sunn O))) in fog at Roskilde Festival, Denmark
years.h: Attila Csihar sings with Sunn O))) for the first time, in Linz
years.p: The [[Mayhem|c5f9e699-7b0d-4030-86dd-7acc8250d147]] vocalist joins them live at Stadtwerkstatt in Linz, Austria. He has done hundreds of shows with them since.
years.xp:
Csihar sang on Mayhem's De Mysteriis Dom Sathanas (1994) after the death of vocalist Dead. Wikipedia lists him as the band's primary vocalist since 2003.

His first studio work with Sunn O))) came on White2 in 2004.

years.h: Julian Cope reads poetry on White1
years.p: Cope speaks on "My Wall", and Runhild Gammelsæter of Thorr's Hammer opens "The Gates of Ballard" in Norwegian. Joe Preston plays guitar, bass and electronics.
years.xp: Wikipedia reports that Q magazine's loud issue ranked White1 18th loudest album ever, between Back in Black and Are You Experienced.

years.h: White2 puts Csihar on record, singing Sanskrit
years.p: He sings on "Decay2 [Nihil's Maw]" and "Decay (The Symptoms of Kali Yuga)". White2 was recorded alongside White1 and came out a year later.

years.h: Black metal voices move into the drone on Black One
years.p: The fifth album brings in Wrest of Leviathan and Malefic of Xasthur. Mathias Schneeberger co-produces.

years.cap: A robed Sunn O))) member at Roskilde Festival, Denmark
years.h: Boris and Sunn O))) put out Altar on Halloween
years.p: The Japanese band and Sunn O))) release the collaboration through Southern Lord, with Jesse Sykes among the guests.
years.xp: The other guests were Joe Preston and Kim Thayil of Soundgarden.

eras.title: A cathedral first, then an orchestra
eras.text: A live set in Bergen Cathedral comes first. Monoliths & Dimensions follows, with brass, a women's choir and viola arrangements by Eyvind Kang.

years.cap: Sunn O))) in robes and fog, Baltimore
years.src: Wikipedia: Sunn O))) · Wikipedia: Sunn O))) discography
years.h: Sunn O))) play a 12th-century cathedral in Bergen
years.p: At the Borealis Festival on March 18, 2007, with Csihar, Steve Moore and Lasse Marhaug. The pipe organ is part of the set.
years.xp:
The live album Dømkirke followed on September 22, 2008, recorded by Isak Strand.

Around its release the band announced a four-date mini-tour for their tenth anniversary.

years.src: Wikipedia: Sunn O))) discography · Wikipedia: Sunn O)))
years.h: Monoliths & Dimensions brings in horns, a harp and a women's choir
years.p: Eyvind Kang arranges and plays viola, with trombonists Julian Priester and Stuart Dempster, Dylan Carlson and Oren Ambarchi. It ends on "Alice", for Alice Coltrane.
years.xp:
It took two years. Mell Dettmer and Randall Dunn produced, and it reached the Top Heatseekers chart. Metacritic scores it 88.

O'Malley called it the most musical and heaviest thing they had done, per Wikipedia.

years.cap: Stephen O'Malley on stage with Sunn O))), 2009
years.src: Wikipedia: Sunn O))) · Wikipedia: Sunn O))) discography
years.h: Scott Walker passes on Monoliths & Dimensions, then makes Soused with them
years.p: The band asked Walker to sing on Monoliths & Dimensions in 2009; he declined for scheduling reasons. Five years on, he was the one who came to them.
years.xp: The 2009 invitation is on the record in Wikipedia's account of Monoliths & Dimensions. Soused came out on 4AD on October 21, 2014, produced by Walker and Peter Walsh.

eras.title: Outsiders get the keys
eras.text: Norwegian art-rockers Ulver come in, then Scott Walker himself. Then comes Kannon, three long pieces in 33 minutes.

years.h: Ulver sessions from 2008 become Terrestrials six years later
years.p: Sunn O))) and the Norwegian group Ulver release the collaboration on Southern Lord, produced by O'Malley and Kristoffer Rygg.

years.src: Wikipedia: Sunn O))) · Wikipedia: Sunn O))) discography
years.h: Sunn O))) haul their whole amp collection to Scott Walker's studio
years.p: For Soused on 4AD they follow Walker's synthesizer demos in London. It reaches No. 88 on the Billboard 200 and is Walker's last studio album.
years.xp: Walker sent O'Malley and Anderson demos outlining the parts they should play. Production credits went to Walker and Peter Walsh. Metacritic scores it 83.

years.src: Wikipedia: Sunn O))) · Wikipedia: Sunn O))) discography
years.h: Kannon is built around Guanyin, the Buddhist goddess of mercy
years.p: Produced by O'Malley, Anderson and Randall Dunn, with Csihar on vocals. Guests include Oren Ambarchi, Steve Moore and Brad Mowen on bass drum.
years.xp: That November the band curated a four-day program at Le Guess Who? in Utrecht, with Annette Peacock, Magma, Julia Holter and the Crazy World of Arthur Brown.

eras.title: Analog tape, two records
eras.text: The band records Life Metal fully analog at Electrical Audio in Chicago with Steve Albini. Pyroclasts comes out six months later.

q: Having children and being a father has really changed me.
years.src: Wikipedia: Sunn O))) · Wikipedia: Sunn O))) discography
yt: Live at The Mayan, Los Angeles, Sept 8, 2019
years.h: Steve Albini tapes Life Metal at Electrical Audio
years.p: Recorded in July 2018, it's the band's first fully analog record, with Hildur Guðnadóttir on cello and Anthony Pateras on pipe organ.
years.xp: The title began as a joke against death metal. Anderson said fatherhood changed how he thought about writing music. Metacritic scores it 85.

years.cap: Sunn O))) in fog before a wall of amps
years.h: Pyroclasts follows Life Metal, from the same sessions
years.p: The improvisational companion, also with Albini, comes out on Southern Lord six months after Life Metal.

eras.title: New label, same two guitarists
eras.text: After two decades mostly on Southern Lord, Sunn O))) signs with Sub Pop and records its tenth album as just Anderson and O'Malley.

years.h: Just the two of them at Bear Creek Studios
years.p: O'Malley and Anderson record their tenth album in Woodinville, Washington, co-produced with Brad Wood, playing everything themselves. Anderson calls the guest-free duo shows of recent years "really fresh and exciting".
years.xp: O'Malley on the room: "The vast tracking room had big windows looking out on trees." Between takes they could "go hiking and be out in the woods."

years.h: Sunn O))) sign to Sub Pop and release Eternity's Pillars the same day
years.p: The maxi-LP pairs Eternity's Pillars with "Raise the Chalice" and "Reverential", produced by the band and Brad Wood.

years.cap: Stephen O'Malley and Greg Anderson in robes, press photo for the self-titled album, 2026
years.src: Sub Pop · Wikipedia: Sunn O))) discography
years.h: The tenth album is self-titled, and the first on Sub Pop
years.p: Six songs on CD, 2xLP and digital, and the first new material since Pyroclasts in 2019. Initial North American headline dates run April 1-19, Phoenix to Montreal.
years.xp: The tracks: "XXANN", "Does Anyone Hear Like Venom?", "Butch's Guns", "Mindrolling", "Everett Moses" and "Glory Black". Brad Wood co-produced and mixed with the band.
